title: Last Call at Kanpai
caption: Hard bop jazz quintet instrumental, swinging and bluesy. Tenor saxophone and trumpet playing the head in unison, confident walking upright bass, crisp swinging drums with ride cymbal and snare accents, bluesy piano comping, a fiery tenor saxophone solo then a trumpet solo. Lively, a crowded small club late at night. Warm vintage live recording. No vocals.
note: Preferred in the listening test (configuration C).
